questions.fact: Peck won the Academy Award for Best Actor for the role.

questions.question: In 'M*A*S*H', who was the commanding officer of the 4077th in the show's early seasons?
questions.fact: Colonel Sherman Potter took over command after Blake left in season three.

questions.question: Which detective did David Suchet play in the long-running Agatha Christie television adaptations?
questions.fact: Suchet played Poirot for 24 years, from 1989 to 2013.

questions.question: Which band released the album 'Hotel California' in 1976?
questions.fact: The album's title track won Record of the Year at the 1978 Grammy Awards.

questions.question: What is the name of the fictional island where 'Jurassic Park' is set?
questions.fact: In the story, the island lies off the coast of Costa Rica.

questions.question: Which actress played Sarah Connor in the 1984 film 'The Terminator'?
questions.fact: Hamilton returned to the role in 'Terminator: Dark Fate' in 2019, 35 years later.

questions.question: Broken Hill, the famous outback mining town, is in which Australian state?
questions.fact: Broken Hill sits in the far west of New South Wales, close to the South Australian border.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Iceland?
questions.fact: Reykjavik is the world's northernmost capital city.

questions.question: In which year did the Titanic sink on its maiden voyage?
questions.fact: The Titanic struck an iceberg in the North Atlantic on 14 April 1912 and sank the next day.

questions.question: Who wrote 'The Lord of the Rings'?
questions.fact: The three volumes were published between 1954 and 1955.

questions.question: What is the term for a word that imitates the sound it describes, like 'buzz' or 'hiss'?
questions.fact: The word comes from Greek, meaning 'name-making'.

questions.question: Which fruit is the main ingredient in traditional marmalade?
questions.fact: Seville oranges are too bitter to eat raw, which is why they are perfect for marmalade.

questions.question: Which gas makes up most of the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.fact: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the air we breathe; oxygen is only about 21%.
